# 1. Load Required Libraries
```{r}
library(qiime2R)
library(phyloseq)
library(TreeSummarizedExperiment)
library(ANCOMBC)
library(S4Vectors)
```

# 2. Create Phyloseq Object Using the New 150-bp Taxonomy Artifact
```{r}
physeq_O <- qza_to_phyloseq(
  features = "filtered-table-genus.qza",
  tree = "tree/rooted_tree.qza",
  taxonomy = "taxa-v3-150.qza",
  metadata = "metadata.tsv"
)

physeq_O
```

# 3. Remove Archaea and Eukaryota
```{r}
physeq_OF <- subset_taxa(physeq_O, Kingdom != "d__Archaea")
physeq_OF <- subset_taxa(physeq_OF, Kingdom != "d__Eukaryota")
physeq_OF

head(tax_table(physeq_OF))
```

# 4. Family-Level Differential Abundance via ANCOM-BC2
```{r}
# 4.1 Agglomerate raw sequence counts at the Family level
# NOTE: Raw count data (not normalized percentages) are required for ANCOM-BC2
physeq_fam_raw <- phyloseq::tax_glom(physeq_OF, taxrank = "Family")

# 4.2 Extract the count matrix (taxa as rows, samples as columns)
raw_counts <- as(physeq_fam_raw@otu_table, "matrix")
if (!phyloseq::taxa_are_rows(physeq_fam_raw)) {
  raw_counts <- t(raw_counts)
}

# 4.3 Extract taxonomy and format family names as unique identifiers
tax_mat <- as(physeq_fam_raw@tax_table, "matrix")
fam_names <- as.character(tax_mat[, "Family"])
fam_names[is.na(fam_names) | fam_names == ""] <- "Unclassified_Family"
rownames(raw_counts) <- make.unique(fam_names)

# 4.4 Extract metadata and enforce factor levels
meta_df <- data.frame(
  group = as.character(physeq_fam_raw@sam_data$group),
  row.names = rownames(physeq_fam_raw@sam_data),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# 4.5 Export input data to a temporary RDS file for clean execution
saveRDS(list(counts = raw_counts, meta = meta_df), file = "ancombc_input_temp.rds")

# 4.6 Execute ANCOM-BC2 in an isolated background R session to avoid namespace conflicts
system2(
  command = R.home("bin/Rscript"),
  args = c("-e", shQuote('
    library(TreeSummarizedExperiment)
    library(ANCOMBC)
    library(S4Vectors)
    
    # Load prepared input data
    dat <- readRDS("ancombc_input_temp.rds")
    meta <- dat$meta
    meta$group <- factor(meta$group, levels = c("CON", "SCP", "CP"))
    
    # Construct TreeSummarizedExperiment object
    tse <- TreeSummarizedExperiment(
      assays = list(counts = dat$counts),
      colData = S4Vectors::DataFrame(meta)
    )
    
    # Execute ANCOM-BC2 pairwise testing
    set.seed(1234)
    out <- ancombc2(
      data = tse,
      assay_name = "counts",
      tax_level = NULL,            # Input matrix is already agglomerated at family level
      fix_formula = "group",
      p_adj_method = "BH",
      prv_cut = 0.10,              # Prevalence threshold: present in >= 10% of samples
      group = "group",
      struc_zero = TRUE,           # Screen for structural zeros
      neg_lb = TRUE,               # Pseudo-count lower bound
      pairwise = TRUE,             # Multi-group pairwise comparisons
      verbose = FALSE
    )
    
    # Export full pairwise differential results to CSV
    write.csv(out$res_pair, "Supplementary Data S4v2. ANCOMBC2 Family Pairwise Results.csv", row.names = FALSE)
    cat("ANCOM-BC2 re-analysis completed successfully.\n")
  '))
)
```


# 5. Inspect Updated Results
```{r}
if (file.exists("Supplementary Data S4v2. ANCOMBC2 Family Pairwise Results.csv")) {
  res_ancom <- read.csv("Supplementary Data S4v2. ANCOMBC2 Family Pairwise Results.csv")
  cat("Output Dimensions:", dim(res_ancom), "\n")
  print(head(res_ancom[, 1:7]))
}
```
